thread:
Vikram: quick bring-up for sirocco13b-greenpath. ran int8, int6, and int4-GPTQ on three slices (short chat, long summary, rerank). dropping a compact cost-vs-quality readout + recommended dynamic routing.

Vikram: perf (prod-like, batch=1, seq=1280):
```
int8 : tp 12.0 r/s, p50 46ms, p95 170ms, p99 380ms, cost ~$0.030 / 1k tok
int6 : tp 10.6 r/s, p50 53ms, p95 200ms, p99 440ms, cost ~$0.022 / 1k tok
int4 : tp 19.8 r/s, p50 29ms, p95 110ms, p99 240ms, cost ~$0.013 / 1k tok
fp16 : tp 8.2 r/s, p50 72ms, p95 260ms, p99 600ms, cost ~$0.052 / 1k tok
```

Vikram: quality (GTN 11k samples):
- fp16 baseline ROUGE-L 0.446
- int8 0.441 (-0.5)
- int6 0.432 (-1.4)
- int4 0.405 (-4.1)

Leah: unit-econ quick calc: assume 1.6k tokens/request -> cost/request: fp16 $0.083, int8 $0.048, int6 $0.035, int4 $0.022. At current fleet, moving 30%->int6 saves ~ $6.5k per 100k req.

Sven: ops notes: int4 KV-alignment issue under tail loads (ticket ML-1407). int6 shows higher p99 under burst but stable after retry. added retry+fallback counters.

Mira: product: where is the quality delta user-visible?

Vikram: most delta shows up on multi-doc synthesis and chain-of-thought style prompts. short Q&A and single-turn completions are fine.

Leah: suggested dynamic policy: route by intent + time-of-day cost-sensitivity. examples:
```json
{"model":"sirocco13b","policies":[{"intent":"short-chat","weights":{"int6":0.7,"int8":0.3}},{"intent":"summarize","weights":{"int8":1.0}},{"intent":"rerank","weights":{"int8":0.8,"int6":0.2}}],"fallback":"int8","canary":5000}
```

Sven: GTN gating (24h smoke): ROUGE-L drop <=1.0 abs on summary slice, p99 latency <=450ms, client error rate <=0.2%. For cheap-tier canary allow ROUGE-L drop <=1.8 if postfilter false-positive <0.5%.

Mira: mitigation roadmap: short quant-finetune (3k steps) expected to recover ~0.8-1.2 ROUGE pts for int6; mixed-precision decode (prefix int4, decode int8) looked promising in bench (+~1.0 ROUGE for int4).

Vikram: decision recs: 1) immediate: canary int6 for short-chat (50%) and pin int8 for summaries; 2) gated int4 for internal cheap-batch behind postfilter only; 3) run 50k signal-focused eval and quant-finetune in parallel.

canary-bot: Canary scheduled: sirocco13b-int6 -> 2024-11-05T23:45Z, samples=5000, owner=Sven. Monitoring: model-latency, rouge-l, errors, fallback-counts.

Leah: I'll prepare the GTN note with cost/payback calc and customer-facing blurb. Sven/Mira: please own the 50k eval and finetune tickets.

Sven: will post canary readouts here after 6h shadow + 24h smoke.

Vikram: closing: pragmatic mix -> int8 for quality paths, int6 for short/chat cost wins, int4 only with strong filters. :thumbsup:
